source_method: Natural recording/Foley world and ambience; recorded gun families; original DSP retained only for explicit system cue allowlist
mix_policy: 44.1kHz PCM24 mono point sources; fixed asset peak headroom; per-family variations; no runtime synthesis fallback
unbound_policy: New document sounds are an authored library; domain hooks require separate verified facts. narrative.fx_sfx dispatches an existing event; amb.radio_local remains owned by MusicManager/Base99Radio3D.
